title: Unnati Hooda Exits China Masters After Opening Round Loss to Kim Ga Eun
indian_angle: India's young talent Unnati Hooda faced an early exit from the China Masters, highlighting the tough international competition.
summary: Indian youngster Unnati Hooda's China Masters campaign concluded in the opening round, as she was defeated by South Korea's Kim Ga Eun with a score of 21-10, 21-18.

title: Unnati Hooda's Asian Games Journey Begins with China Masters After Worlds Heartbreak
